name: Wallet Deposit Intent
status: CURRENT source contract; EXPERIMENTAL first release v1
purpose: Authorize private settlement instructions associated with wallet funding; the intent defines what the funding is for, independently of a later TIN-Credit or wallet delivery
contractBoundary: Catalog of existing funding ABIs, current native coordination and the required private-intent contract; no new instruction, destination dispatcher or privacy guarantee is enabled by this record

intent.destination: Current native ingress requires recipientTin and recipientHash; Node resolves the authenticated TIN route for later TIN-Credit
intent.authorization: Sender signs the canonical payment message binding recipient TIN and displayed identity, asset, amount, fee, nonce, expiry and funding-note commitment before approving the exact deposit transaction; Node independently resolves the route
intent.initialIngress: Message authorization only; no signed deposit or blockhash context
intent.readiness: Node verification produces FUNDING_READY for the original work; this status supplies no Cranker execution or confirmed funding

signedAttachment.effect: Attach the exact wallet-approved deposit to the same versioned authorized work; no new intent or recipient substitution

intent.execution: Node checks the signed instruction/accounts/amount/note and returns a verified execution projection; Cranker submits the owner-signed wire unchanged
intent.completion: Confirmed funding enables independent settlement verification; deposit confirmation alone does not establish recipient credit or wallet delivery
intent.recovery: Reconcile the original work and chain signatures before preparing another deposit; changing a signed blockhash invalidates its authorization

encoding: 8-byte Anchor discriminator followed by Borsh fields

tinCredit.scope: Current native funded-note intent path; credit is separately authorized, proved and confirmed

walletDelivery.scope: Wallet-to-wallet settlement is a distinct purpose and must not be described as TIN-Credit
walletDelivery.sourceCapability: PublicWallet is a mode in the retained intent-bearing TCAP funding claim; separately, retained TSNP tsn_execute_private_payout transfers tokens under its Epoch Treasury, Settlement DNA and CrankerVault contract
walletDelivery.integrationBoundary: No current caller/consumer connects the intent-bearing funding claim to wallet delivery. Current CreateIntentRequest and Receiver native funding ingress require a TIN
walletDelivery.directWalletUtility: buildTsnSplTokenTransferTransaction builds an ordinary SPL wallet transfer, without TCAP deposit or TSN intent

verificationBoundary: Catalog extracted from current source; does not establish deployment, current chain state, a live deposit or end-to-end wallet delivery

intentBearingClaim.scope: Distinct retained source capability with public intent metadata; not compliant with required private intent and no current SDK/Node/Cranker caller or claim settlement consumer was found

fundingRoot.boundary: Per-asset commitment chain; distinct from the native global funded-note Merkle tree

intentBearingClaim.validation: Positive amount; nonzero destination/funding-ID/fee/randomness commitments; supported mode; future expiry; exact domain and computed commitment; sequential depositor nonce; governed source/vault/asset and exact transferred amount
intentBearingClaim.stateEffect: Transfer tokens into reserve and add actual assets/pending obligations; atomically create a Pending claim, advance per-asset funding commitment chain and depositor nonce
intentBearingClaim.recipientParticipation: No recipient signer; destination is a commitment in the depositor-signed transaction
intentBearingClaim.privacyBoundary: Public amount, depositor and claim; destination commitment is not a demonstrated unlinkability guarantee; raw client randomness is absent
intentBearingClaim.completionBoundary: PublicWallet mode does not transfer to the destination wallet; only Pending exists in FundingClaimStatusV1. Claim consumption, service integration and live settlement remain outstanding

nativeFundedNote.stateEffect: Actual token transfer to governed vault; add actual assets and pending obligations; atomically append funded leaf/current retained root
nativeFundedNote.authorization: Depositor signs exact wallet funding transaction; source token owner and governed asset/vault/reserve policy are checked
nativeFundedNote.recipientParticipation: No recipient signer in the deposit ABI; destination and subsequent action belong to the applicable intent/settlement contract
nativeFundedNote.privacyBoundary: Wallet address and deposit amount are public; this instruction does not contain a recipient TIN
nativeFundedNote.scope: Current native funded-note funding used by separately coordinated TIN-Credit

reserveOnly.stateEffect: Actual token transfer to governed vault; add actual assets and pending obligations; no funded-note leaf append or recipient credit
reserveOnly.boundary: Distinct retained source capability; it is not accepted in place of deposit_private_funding_v1 by current native TIN-credit ingress

privacy.requirementStatus: REQUIRED for Wallet Deposit Intent; current source coverage is partial and does not establish end-to-end privacy
privacy.requiredIntentBoundary: All deposit purposes, including TIN credit and wallet delivery, keep recipient identity/destination, settlement purpose/route, authorization message/signature, private note opening and payment-specific instructions out of public work views and plaintext transaction data
privacy.trustedProcessing: Sender approval and authorized Receiver/Node validation may inspect intent data; existing Receiver storage encryption is a service trust boundary, not client-to-Node encryption excluding Receiver
privacy.publicFundingBoundary: Current ordinary SPL reserve deposits reveal sender/source, token, vault, amount, signature and timing. Hiding intent does not hide these funding facts or prove deposit-to-settlement unlinkability

currentNative.restrictedStorage: Receiver encrypts full native ingress with AES-256-GCM and retains paymentId plus recipientHash outside the envelope; authenticated Node projection decrypts it
currentNative.publicFundingView: For fundingPhase work, publicCoordinationPayload allowlists paymentId only; public status still exposes coordination metadata, commitments and transaction results
currentNative.otherPublicViews: Work without fundingPhase may expose paymentId, intentId, recipientHash, source, tokenMintAddress and amount when present; complete lifecycle privacy requires further review
currentNative.onchainDeposit: deposit_private_funding_v1 carries amount and note commitment, with no plaintext destination or purpose field

retainedIntentClaim.status: Does not meet the required intent-hiding boundary
retainedIntentClaim.limitation: deposit_with_funding_commitment_v2 serializes these fields publicly and persists claim metadata; a committed destination is not a private intent or a demonstrated unlinkability guarantee

privacy.remainingWork: An implementation meeting the requirement needs reviewed private intent binding and consumption for each destination, public projection/record review and transaction/observer evidence. The retained claim is a source capability, not an approved privacy-preserving replacement for native funded notes
